        put(c["mb"]["qf"], s * QF + (h * IDX_DIM + lane) // 4, words[0], tag)
        put(c["mb"]["qf"], s * QF + (h * IDX_DIM + lane + 64) // 4, words[1], tag)
    if lane == 0:
        put(c["mb"]["qf"], s * QF + IDX_HEADS * IDX_DIM // 4 + h, _bits(gate), tag)


def _pick(values, i):
    """values[i] of a list of wave-uniform values, i dynamic."""
    out = values[0]
    for r in range_constexpr(1, len(values)):
        out = (i == r).select(values[r], out)
    return out


def _score_groups(c):
    """(seq_lens, first row, rows) by row of L's groups: up to GROUP consecutive rows of one request, a row joining
    the previous row's group when its page table maps that row's position to the slot that row writes (a page
    being written is its request's alone), its position is the next and it has more than GROUP_KEYS keys."""
    s = c["s"]
    n = [ld_i32(c["seq_lens"], r) for r in range(s)]
    firsts, first, run = [fx.Int32(0)], fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(1)
    for r in range(1, s):
        pos = n[r - 1] - 1
        slot = ld_i32(c["page_table"], r * c["max_pages"] + pos // PAGE) * PAGE + pos % PAGE
        joins = (slot == ld_i32(c["cache_locations"], (r - 1) * 2)) & (n[r] == n[r - 1] + 1) & (run < GROUP)
        joins = joins & (n[r] > GROUP_KEYS)
        first = joins.select(first, fx.Int32(r))
        run = joins.select(run + 1, fx.Int32(1))
        firsts.append(first)
    sizes = [sum(((f == g).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)) for g in firsts), fx.Int32(0)) for f in firsts]
    return n, firsts, sizes


def _page_tables(c, row, p0, n_pages, stride):
    """Pages p0, p0 + stride, .. (L_PAGES) of row's as index-K pages: past its n_pages, page p0's (scored, not
    stored), or page 0's past them all."""
    p0 = (p0 < n_pages).select(p0, fx.Int32(0))
    ps = [p0 + j * stride for j in range(L_PAGES)]
    return [ld_i32(c["page_table"], row * c["max_pages"] + (p < n_pages).select(p, p0)) for p in ps]


@flyc.jit
def stage_l(c, t):
    """Part t % lparts of row t // lparts, with its group's other rows' parts (_score_groups) one part of the
    group's: its pages p = part * WAVES + wave, + parts * WAVES, .. of the group's keys, a page a wave, each page's
    keys loaded once and scored for each row of the group, once every row's key is stored; into
    scores at device scope, each with the launch's tag (TG's polled pairs). Then the task's done flag."""
    tid, lane, tag, err, lds = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["tag"], c["err"], c["lds"]
    lparts = c["lparts"]
    row, part = t // lparts, t % lparts
    n_all, firsts, sizes = _score_groups(c)
    first, m = _pick(firsts, row), _pick(sizes, row)
    rows = [fx.min(first + k, first + m - 1) for k in range(GROUP)]
    ns = [_pick(n_all, r) for r in rows]
    box = c["mb"]["qf"]
    words = IDX_HEADS * IDX_DIM // 4
    q_words = words + IDX_HEADS
    per = words // 2 // THREADS
    # one wait for every row's query words and gates (a thread past the gates polls its row's first again)
    q_at = [rows[k] * QF + 2 * (i * THREADS + tid) for k in range(GROUP) for i in range(per)]
    g_at = [rows[k] * QF + words + 2 * (tid % (IDX_HEADS // 2)) for k in range(GROUP)]
    got = poll2n(box, q_at + g_at, tag, err, batch=len(q_at) + len(g_at))
    for k in range_constexpr(GROUP):
        base = lds + k * q_words
        for i in range_constexpr(per):
            for j in range_constexpr(2):
                fx.ptr_store(_f32(got[k * per + i][j]), base + 2 * (i * THREADS + tid) + j)
        if tid < IDX_HEADS // 2:
            for j in range_constexpr(2):
                fx.ptr_store(_f32(got[len(q_at) + k][j]), base + words + 2 * tid + j)
    if tid < c["s"]:
        poll1(c["mb"]["ik_done"], tid, tag, err)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    q_ops = [query_operands(lambda i: _bits(fx.ptr_load(lds + k * q_words + i)), lane) for k in range(GROUP)]
    gates = [
        [
            [fx.ptr_load(lds + k * q_words + words + hb * 16 + (lane // 16) * 4 + i) for i in range(4)]
            for hb in range(IDX_HEADS // 16)
        ]
        for k in range(GROUP)
    ]
    # the group's last row reads every key the others do, through the same pages
    last = rows[GROUP - 1]
    n_pages = (ns[GROUP - 1] + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
    stride = m * lparts * WAVES
    start = ((row - first) * lparts + part) * WAVES + c["wave"]
    # the next pages' table entries load while these pages are scored
    t0, t1, t2, t3 = _page_tables(c, last, start, n_pages, stride)
    for p0 in range(start, n_pages, stride * L_PAGES):
        ps = [p0 + j * stride for j in range(L_PAGES)]
        # a page's resource from its wave-uniform table entry read as a scalar (else each load a waterfall loop)
        loaded = [
            page_words(rsrc(c["index_k_cache"] + fx.Int64(uniform(i)) * PAGE_BYTES), lane) for i in (t0, t1, t2, t3)
        ]
        t0, t1, t2, t3 = _page_tables(c, last, p0 + stride * L_PAGES, n_pages, stride)
        for j in range_constexpr(L_PAGES):
            if ps[j] < n_pages:
                keys, scale = loaded[j]
                at = ps[j] * PAGE + lane
                for k in range_constexpr(GROUP):
                    if (k < m) & (ps[j] * PAGE < ns[k]):
                        score = page_scores(q_ops[k], gates[k], keys, scale, lane)
                        word = fx.Float32((at < ns[k]).select(score, fx.Float32(float("-inf")))).bitcast(fx.Int32)
                        put(c["scores"], rows[k] * c["max_pages"] * PAGE + at, word, tag)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if tid == 0:
        put(c["mb"]["l_done"], t, fx.Int32(1), tag)


def _row_scores(c, row):
    """Row's scores' resource: (score, tag) pairs."""
    return rsrc(c["scores_addr"] + fx.Int64(row) * (c["max_pages"] * PAGE) * 8)


@flyc.jit
def _wait_scores(c):
    """Every L task's flag: a row's scores come from any of its group's tasks."""
    if c["tid"] < c["lparts"] * c["s"]:
        poll1(c["mb"]["l_done"], c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"])
    fx.gpu.barrier()


@flyc.jit
def _block_prefix(c, values):
    """Each of ``values`` (int32 a thread): (its sum over the workgroup's threads before this one, its total), by
    a butterfly a wave, then the earlier waves' totals (c["misc"])."""
    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
    out = []
    for i in range_constexpr(len(values)):
        below, total = fx.Int32(0), values[i]
        for off in (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
            other = xshfl(total, off)
            below = ((lane & off) != 0).select(below + other, below)
            total = total + other
        out.append([below, total])
    for i in range_constexpr(len(values)):
        if lane == 0:
            fx.ptr_store(out[i][1], c["misc"] + i * WAVES + wave)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    res = []
    for i in range_constexpr(len(values)):
        before, total = fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(0)
        for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
            k = fx.ptr_load(c["misc"] + i * WAVES + w)
            before, total = before + (fx.Int32(w) < wave).select(k, fx.Int32(0)), total + k
        res.append((out[i][0] + before, total))
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    return res


# TG's radix select (sgl-amd-mono's index_slice): (shift, bits) of the scores' unsigned order keys, high digits
# first; a digit's histogram is 64 bins, a slice's put as 16 pairs of two words of two 16-bit counts
SL_DIGITS = ((26, 6), (20, 6), (14, 6), (8, 6), (2, 6), (0, 2))
SL_SLICES = 64  # the most slices a row (their histograms polled 4 pairs a thread)
SL_CAP = 4096  # the most keys under a 12- or 24-bit prefix whose rest the row's first slice takes
SL_LDS = 16  # the most rounds of the slices' THREADS * 4 keys: a slice's keys, in LDS (64 KB)
ROW_KEYS = SL_LDS * SL_SLICES * THREADS * 4  # the most keys a row scores: GLM-5.3's longest context, 2^20
# TG's words in hist: each wave's 64 bins; each wave's sums of every slice's 64 and of the slices' before this one;
# the state (each wave updates it alike), then each wave's slot of 8
SL_PART, SL_ST = 4 * 64, 12 * 64
PREFIX, NEED, ABOVE_ALL, ABOVE_BEFORE, IN_ALL, IN_BEFORE, DONE, DECIDED, DIGIT, REMAIN, IN_BIN, A_ALL = range(12)
SL_PT = SL_LDS * THREADS * 4  # in LDS past the slice's keys: each 4 keys' page's first KV slot
CODE_WARM = 1 << 16  # the bytes of code a stage warms (warm_code) while its inputs are pending
SL_RBINS = 1 << 10  # the first slice's bins a digit of its candidates' last 20 bits (or 8)


def _sl_task(c, t):
    """TG's task t: (its row, its slice of the row, whether it is one, the slicing). A row's slices wait on each
    other's histograms, so they are one round's tasks: CTAS // s a row, every row's in one round, while each row's
    keys fit SL_LDS rounds of them; else SL_SLICES a row, whole rows a round. The slicing: (whether the latter, the
    slices a row otherwise); up to 4 rows the two are alike, and whether is None."""
    s, one = c["s"], CTAS // c["s"]
    if one >= SL_SLICES:
        row, part, sl = t // SL_SLICES, t % SL_SLICES, (None, SL_SLICES)
    else:
        fit = SL_LDS * one * THREADS * 4
        wide = ld_i32(c["seq_lens"], 0) > fit
        for r in range(1, s):
            wide = wide | (ld_i32(c["seq_lens"], r) > fit)
        row, part, sl = wide.select(t // SL_SLICES, t // one), wide.select(t % SL_SLICES, t % one), (wide, one)
    return fx.min(row, s - 1), part, row < s, sl


def _sl_step(sl):
    """A round of a row's slices' keys in the slicing ``sl`` (_sl_task's)."""
    wide, one = sl
    step = SL_SLICES * THREADS * 4
    return step if wide is None else wide.select(fx.Int32(step), fx.Int32(one * THREADS * 4))


def _sl_div(sl, x):
    """x // _sl_step(sl), by a constant either way."""
    wide, one = sl
    whole = x // (SL_SLICES * THREADS * 4)
    return whole if wide is None else wide.select(whole, x // (one * THREADS * 4))


@flyc.jit
def _sl_stage(c, row, part, n, sl, warm):
    """TG's slice's keys (unsigned order keys) into LDS, the thread's round j's at (j THREADS + tid) 4, and their
    pages' first KV slots at SL_PT + j THREADS + tid (4 keys from a multiple of 4 share a page): the scores polled
    from their tagged pairs (no wait on L's flags), SCAN rounds' a batch with their page table entries; ``warm``
    (warm_code's words) held once they are in; the keys' first digit counted as they go in (_sl_round's
    first, a wave its own 64 bins in hist)."""
    step, start = _sl_step(sl), (part * THREADS + c["tid"]) * 4
    bins, (shift, bits) = c["hist"] + c["wave"] * 64, SL_DIGITS[0]
    fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(0), bins + c["lane"])
    r = _row_scores(c, row)
    for i0 in range(start, n, step * SCAN):
        firsts = [i0 + j * step for j in range(SCAN)]
        pts = [ld_i32(c["page_table"], row * c["max_pages"] + fx.min(i, n - 1) // PAGE) for i in firsts]
        # an i past n polls i0's (its pairs are written): pairs i .. i + 3 as two of two
        pairs = [(i < n).select(i, i0) + 2 * h for i in firsts for h in (0, 1)]
        got = poll2n(r, pairs, c["tag"], c["err"], batch=2 * SCAN)
        for j in range_constexpr(SCAN):
            i, v, pt = firsts[j], [w.bitcast(fx.Float32) for w in got[2 * j] + got[2 * j + 1]], pts[j]
            if i < n:
                q = _sl_div(sl, i - start) * THREADS + c["tid"]
                for k in range_constexpr(4):
                    u = unsigned_key(v[k])
                    fx.ptr_store(u.bitcast(fx.Float32), c["lds"] + q * 4 + k)
                    if i + k < n:
                        at = bins + ((u >> shift) & fx.Int32((1 << bits) - 1))
                        fx.atomic_add(at, fx.Int32(1), syncscope="workgroup")
                fx.ptr_store((pt * PAGE).bitcast(fx.Float32), c["lds"] + SL_PT + q)
    hold(warm)
    fx.gpu.barrier()


@flyc.jit
def _sl_round(c, row, part, n, sl, level):
    """TG's digit SL_DIGITS[level] of row's top-k: the slice's keys (_sl_stage's) under the state's prefix counted
    by digit (a wave its own 64 bins in hist), put into mailbox slh; every slice's polled, summed and those before
    this one's too (three barriers a round); then every wave alike: the digit holding the need-th key from the top,
    the slices before this one's keys above it and in it, the state moved on: its prefix, the keys still needed,
    those above it in the row and in the slices before, those in its bin, done once 12 or 24 bits leave at most
    SL_CAP keys under it or all 32 are decided."""
    tid, lane, wave, tag, err, h = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["tag"], c["err"], c["hist"]
    shift, bits = SL_DIGITS[level]
    top, st = shift + bits, h + SL_ST
    prefix, need = fx.ptr_load(st + PREFIX), fx.ptr_load(st + NEED)
    # read before any wave's update below (past this round's barriers): every wave moves the state on alike
    above_all, above_before = fx.ptr_load(st + ABOVE_ALL), fx.ptr_load(st + ABOVE_BEFORE)
    mask = fx.Int32((((1 << (32 - top)) - 1) << top) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    # the first digit's counted by _sl_stage; a wave's own bins: their last reader (the put below) is past the
    # previous round's barriers
    if const_expr(level > 0):
        fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(0), h + wave * 64 + lane)
        step, start = _sl_step(sl), (part * THREADS + tid) * 4
        for j in range(fx.Int32(0), _sl_div(sl, n - start + step - 1), fx.Int32(1)):
            at, i = c["lds"] + (j * THREADS + tid) * 4, start + j * step
            for k in range_constexpr(4):
                u = fx.ptr_load(at + k).bitcast(fx.Int32)
                if ((u & mask) == prefix) & (i + k < n):
                    b = h + wave * 64 + ((u >> shift) & fx.Int32((1 << bits) - 1))
                    fx.atomic_add(b, fx.Int32(1), syncscope="workgroup")
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    base = (row * len(SL_DIGITS) + level) * SL_SLICES * 32
    if tid < 16:
        words = []
        for e in range_constexpr(2):
            pair = []
            for b in range_constexpr(2):
                total = fx.ptr_load(h + 4 * tid + 2 * e + b)
                for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
                    total = total + fx.ptr_load(h + w * 64 + 4 * tid + 2 * e + b)
                pair.append(total)
            words.append(pair[0] | (pair[1] << 16))
        put2(c["mb"]["slh"], base + part * 32 + 2 * tid, words[0], words[1], tag)
    # every slice's: address q = tid + k THREADS, slice q // 16's bins 4 (q % 16) .. + 3 (the thread's, every k);
    # past the row's slices the last's, counted as none
    n_addr = _sl_step(sl) // (THREADS * 4) * 16
    qs = [tid + k * THREADS for k in range(SL_SLICES * 16 // THREADS)]
    got = poll2n(c["mb"]["slh"], [base + fx.min(q, n_addr - 1) // 16 * 32 + tid % 16 * 2 for q in qs], tag, err)
    low = fx.Int32(0xFFFF)
    counts = [
        [(qs[k] < n_addr).select(v, fx.Int32(0)) for w in got[k] for v in (w & low, (w >> 16) & low)]
        for k in range(len(qs))
    ]
    g, b4 = tid // 16, tid % 16 * 4
    # the thread's 4 bins over its slices and over those before this one, then over the wave's lanes alike in
    # tid % 16; its 16 lanes' into LDS, a wave's 64 bins and 64 befores
    tot, bef = [], []
    for e in range_constexpr(4):
        t_e, b_e = counts[0][e], (g < part).select(counts[0][e], fx.Int32(0))
        for k in range_constexpr(1, len(qs)):
            t_e, b_e = t_e + counts[k][e], b_e + (g + 16 * k < part).select(counts[k][e], fx.Int32(0))
        tot.append(t_e)
        bef.append(b_e)
    sums = xor_reduce_all(tot + bef, (16, 32), add)
    if lane < 16:
        for e in range_constexpr(4):
            fx.ptr_store(sums[e], h + SL_PART + wave * 128 + b4 + e)
            fx.ptr_store(sums[4 + e], h + SL_PART + wave * 128 + 64 + b4 + e)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    # every wave alike: lane l bin 63 - l, its keys in the row and in the slices before this one, the bins above
    # it by a butterfly; the bin holding the need-th key's numbers through the wave's slot (its lanes in order)
    cnt, bfr = fx.ptr_load(h + SL_PART + 63 - lane), fx.ptr_load(h + SL_PART + 127 - lane)
    for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
        cnt = cnt + fx.ptr_load(h + SL_PART + w * 128 + 63 - lane)
        bfr = bfr + fx.ptr_load(h + SL_PART + w * 128 + 127 - lane)
    below, total, below_b, total_b = fx.Int32(0), cnt, fx.Int32(0), bfr
    for off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
        hi, other, other_b = (lane & off) != 0, xshfl(total, off), xshfl(total_b, off)
        below, below_b = hi.select(below + other, below), hi.select(below_b + other_b, below_b)
        total, total_b = total + other, total_b + other_b
    slot = st + 16 + wave * 8
    if (below < need) & (below + cnt >= need):
        fx.ptr_store(63 - lane, slot)
        fx.ptr_store(need - below, slot + 1)
        fx.ptr_store(cnt, slot + 2)
        fx.ptr_store(below, slot + 3)
        fx.ptr_store(below_b, slot + 4)
        fx.ptr_store(bfr, slot + 5)
    digit, remain, in_bin, a_all, a_before, i_before = [fx.ptr_load(slot + i) for i in range(6)]
    if lane == 0:
        decided = 32 - shift
        fx.ptr_store(prefix | (digit << shift), st + PREFIX)
        fx.ptr_store(remain, st + NEED)
        fx.ptr_store(above_all + a_all, st + ABOVE_ALL)
        fx.ptr_store(above_before + a_before, st + ABOVE_BEFORE)
        fx.ptr_store(in_bin, st + IN_ALL)
        fx.ptr_store(i_before, st + IN_BEFORE)
        fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(decided), st + DECIDED)
        if const_expr(shift == 0):
            fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(1), st + DONE)
        elif const_expr(decided in (12, 24)):
            fx.ptr_store((in_bin <= SL_CAP).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)), st + DONE)
    fx.gpu.barrier()


@flyc.jit
def _sl_resolve(c, row, out, prefix, need, above_all, n_cand, decided):
    """TG's row's first slice: the row's n_cand candidates (keys under prefix's decided bits, with their slots, from
    mailbox slc) into LDS, the threshold's other bits by two more digits (10 and 10 after 12 bits, 8 after 24:
    select_digit on SL_RBINS of hist's last BINS words), then the candidates above it and need's rest of its ties
    at places above_all on."""
    tid, tag, err = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"]
    keys, slots = c["lds"], c["lds"] + SL_CAP
    per = SL_CAP // THREADS
    # one wait for all (the slice's own keys in LDS read by then: they are where the candidates go)
    cs = [tid + q * THREADS for q in range(per)]
    got = poll2n(c["mb"]["slc"], [(row * SL_CAP + fx.min(ci, n_cand - 1)) * 2 for ci in cs], tag, err, batch=per)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    for q in range_constexpr(per):
        if cs[q] < n_cand:
            fx.ptr_store(got[q][0].bitcast(fx.Float32), keys + cs[q])
            fx.ptr_store(got[q][1].bitcast(fx.Float32), slots + cs[q])
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    hist = c["hist"] + (GROUP - 1) * BINS
    first = (decided == 12).select(fx.Int32(10), fx.Int32(8))
    # the two digits a loop, not unrolled: code run once a launch (on the rows' first slices) costs its fetch
    for p in range(fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(2), fx.Int32(1)):
        # pass 1 after 24 bits takes the last 8: its pass 2 counts every tie in bin 0, the prefix as it was
        d0 = decided + p * first
        bits = (p == 0).select(first, fx.Int32(32) - d0)
        shift = fx.Int32(32) - d0 - bits
        mask = fx.Int32(-1) << (fx.Int32(32) - d0)
        clear_hist(hist, tid, SL_RBINS)
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        for ci in range(tid, n_cand, THREADS):
            u = fx.ptr_load(keys + ci).bitcast(fx.Int32)
            if (u & mask) == prefix:
                at = hist + ((u >> shift) & ((fx.Int32(1) << bits) - 1))
                fx.atomic_add(at, fx.Int32(1), syncscope="workgroup")
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        digit, above = select_digit(hist, need, tid, c["misc"], SL_RBINS)
        need, prefix = need - above, prefix | (digit << shift)
    # prefix: the INDEX_TOPK-th key; need: its ties to take
    thr, one, zero = prefix ^ fx.Int32(SIGN), fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)
    idx = [fx.min(tid + q * THREADS, n_cand - 1) for q in range(per)]
    valid = [tid + q * THREADS < n_cand for q in range(per)]
    ks = [fx.ptr_load(keys + i).bitcast(fx.Int32) for i in idx]
    above = [v & ((k ^ fx.Int32(SIGN)) > thr) for k, v in zip(ks, valid)]
    tie = [v & (k == prefix) for k, v in zip(ks, valid)]
    n_above, n_tie = zero, zero
    for q in range_constexpr(per):
        n_above, n_tie = n_above + above[q].select(one, zero), n_tie + tie[q].select(one, zero)
    (at_above, all_above), (at_tie, all_tie) = _block_prefix(c, [n_above, n_tie])
    # their slots into LDS at their places (past the candidates'), then out a place a thread
    placed = c["lds"] + 2 * SL_CAP
    for q in range_constexpr(per):
        slot = fx.ptr_load(slots + idx[q])
        if above[q]:
            fx.ptr_store(slot, placed + at_above)
        if tie[q] & (at_tie < need):
            fx.ptr_store(slot, placed + all_above + at_tie)
        at_above, at_tie = at_above + above[q].select(one, zero), at_tie + tie[q].select(one, zero)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    for j in range(tid, all_above + fx.min(all_tie, need), THREADS):
        placed_slot = fx.ptr_load(placed + j).bitcast(fx.Int32)
        bo.buffer_store(placed_slot, c["topk_indices"], out + above_all + j, cache_modifier=CM_DEV)
        put(c["mb"]["tk"], out + above_all + j, placed_slot, tag)


@flyc.jit
def _sl_place(c, row, part, n, sl, out):
    """TG's slice's keys above the state's prefix (its decided bits higher: unsigned, so signed once the sign bit is
    flipped) as KV slots into topk_indices after the slices before this one's, the thread's after the threads'
    before it; its keys under the prefix ties placed (32 bits) or candidates put into mailbox slc for the row's
    first slice. The slice's keys (_sl_stage's) twice: counted, then placed."""
    tid, tag, st = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["hist"] + SL_ST
    prefix, need, decided = fx.ptr_load(st + PREFIX), fx.ptr_load(st + NEED), fx.ptr_load(st + DECIDED)
    above_all, above_before = fx.ptr_load(st + ABOVE_ALL), fx.ptr_load(st + ABOVE_BEFORE)
    in_before = fx.ptr_load(st + IN_BEFORE)
    mask, thr = fx.Int32(-1) << (fx.Int32(32) - decided), prefix ^ fx.Int32(SIGN)
    step, start = _sl_step(sl), (part * THREADS + tid) * 4
    one, zero = fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)
    n_above, n_in = zero, zero
    n_j = _sl_div(sl, n - start + step - 1)
    for j in range(fx.Int32(0), n_j, fx.Int32(1)):
        at, i = c["lds"] + (j * THREADS + tid) * 4, start + j * step
        for k in range_constexpr(4):
            m, valid = fx.ptr_load(at + k).bitcast(fx.Int32) & mask, i + k < n
            n_above = n_above + (((m ^ fx.Int32(SIGN)) > thr) & valid).select(one, zero)
            n_in = n_in + ((m == prefix) & valid).select(one, zero)
    (a_below, _), (i_below, _) = _block_prefix(c, [n_above, n_in])
    at_above, at_in = above_before + a_below, in_before + i_below
    for j in range(fx.Int32(0), n_j, fx.Int32(1)):
        at, i = c["lds"] + (j * THREADS + tid) * 4, start + j * step
        page0 = fx.ptr_load(c["lds"] + SL_PT + j * THREADS + tid).bitcast(fx.Int32) + i % PAGE
        for k in range_constexpr(4):
            u, valid = fx.ptr_load(at + k).bitcast(fx.Int32), i + k < n
            m = u & mask
            is_above, is_in = ((m ^ fx.Int32(SIGN)) > thr) & valid, (m == prefix) & valid
            if is_above:
                bo.buffer_store(page0 + k, c["topk_indices"], out + at_above, cache_modifier=CM_DEV)
                put(c["mb"]["tk"], out + at_above, page0 + k, tag)
            if is_in:
                slot_e = page0 + k
                if decided == 32:
                    if at_in < need:
                        at_e = out + above_all + at_in
                        bo.buffer_store(slot_e, c["topk_indices"], at_e, cache_modifier=CM_DEV)
                        put(c["mb"]["tk"], at_e, slot_e, tag)
                else:
                    put2(c["mb"]["slc"], (row * SL_CAP + at_in) * 2, u, slot_e, tag)
            at_above = at_above + is_above.select(one, zero)
            at_in = at_in + is_in.select(one, zero)


@flyc.jit
def stage_tg(c, t):
    """A slice's (_sl_task's) share of its row's top INDEX_TOPK index scores as KV slots into topk_indices at
    device scope, in one stage (sgl-amd-mono's index_slice). Past INDEX_TOPK keys: the slice's keys into LDS once
    (_sl_stage), a radix select by SL_DIGITS (_sl_round) until a prefix of 12 or 24 bits holds the INDEX_TOPK-th
    score with at most SL_CAP keys under it, or all 32 bits do; then the slice's keys above the prefix take their
    places and its keys under it are ties placed or candidates handed on (_sl_place) to the row's first slice,
    which takes the rest (_sl_resolve). A shorter row's, all its slots, in slice 0 alone (row_topk). Every slot
    into topk_indices also with the launch's tag into mailbox tk (S polls its part's). A row past ROW_KEYS keys
    selects none: S's wait for its top-k times out."""
    tid, st = c["tid"], c["hist"] + SL_ST
    row, part, live, sl = _sl_task(c, t)
    n = ld_i32(c["seq_lens"], row)
    out = row * INDEX_TOPK
    if live & (n > INDEX_TOPK) & (n <= ROW_KEYS):
        # the selection's code (and the stages' after it) into L2 while the scores are pending
        warm = warm_code(CODE_WARM)
        if tid < 8:
            fx.ptr_store((tid == NEED).select(fx.Int32(INDEX_TOPK), fx.Int32(0)), st + tid)
        _sl_stage(c, row, part, n, sl, warm)
        for level in range_constexpr(len(SL_DIGITS)):
            if fx.ptr_load(st + DONE) == 0:
                _sl_round(c, row, part, n, sl, level)
        _sl_place(c, row, part, n, sl, out)
        prefix, need, decided = fx.ptr_load(st + PREFIX), fx.ptr_load(st + NEED), fx.ptr_load(st + DECIDED)
        if (part == 0) & (decided < 32):
            _sl_resolve(c, row, out, prefix, need, fx.ptr_load(st + ABOVE_ALL), fx.ptr_load(st + IN_ALL), decided)
    elif live & (n <= INDEX_TOPK) & (part == 0):
        _wait_scores(c)
        pt_base = row * c["max_pages"]
        r = _row_scores(c, row)
        tagged = (c["mb"]["tk"], c["tag"])
        row_topk(r, n, c["page_table"], pt_base, c["topk_indices"], out, tid, c["hist"], c["misc"], CM_DEV, 2, tagged)


@flyc.jit
def stage_k(c, s):
    tid, tag, err = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"]
    row_lds, red = c["lds"], c["lds"] + KV_DIM
    pos = ld_i32(c["positions"], s * 2)  # the low word of an int64 position
    slot = uniform(ld_i32(c["cache_locations"], s * 2))  # a scalar: the pool row's resource is made from it
    i, h = tid % 32, tid // 32
    cos, sin = (ld_f32(c["cos_sin_cache"], pos * PE + i), ld_f32(c["cos_sin_cache"], pos * PE + PE // 2 + i))
    g = bf16_values(ld_i32(c["kv_a_norm_weight"], tid))
    # one wait for all: the latent pair, k_pe's pair i (every 32 threads alike), each of qkv_a's two k ranges', and
    # head h's q_pe pair i
    lat, kpe = s * QKV_A + Q_LORA + 2 * tid, s * QKV_A + Q_LORA + KV_LORA + 2 * i
    qkv, qkv2 = c["mb"]["qkv"], c["mb"]["qkv2"]
    got = [
        (_f32(v0), _f32(v1))
        for v0, v1 in poll2n(
            [qkv, qkv, qkv2, qkv2, c["mb"]["q"]], [lat, kpe, lat, kpe, s * Q_B + h * HEAD_Q + NOPE + 2 * i], tag, err
        )
    ]
    (x0, x1), (k0, k1) = [(a0 + b0, a1 + b1) for (a0, a1), (b0, b1) in zip(got[:2], got[2:4])]
    p0, p1 = got[4]
    inv = rsq(block_reduce(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1, red, tid, add) / KV_LORA + c["eps"])
    fx.ptr_store(x0 * inv * g[0], row_lds + 2 * tid)
    fx.ptr_store(x1 * inv * g[1], row_lds + 2 * tid + 1)
    if tid < 32:
        fx.ptr_store(k0 * cos - k1 * sin, row_lds + KV_LORA + 2 * i)
        fx.ptr_store(k1 * cos + k0 * sin, row_lds + KV_LORA + 2 * i + 1)
    r0, r1 = p0 * cos - p1 * sin, p1 * cos + p0 * sin
    n = (s * HEADS + h) * KV_DIM + KV_LORA + 2 * i
    put(c["mb"]["query"], n // 2, bf16_pair(r0, r1), tag)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    kvw = kv_words(c["bf16_kv"])
    if tid < KV_DIM // 4:
        v = [fx.ptr_load(row_lds + 4 * tid + e) for e in range(4)]
        # the pool's row at a 64-bit slot offset, past 32-bit buffer offsets; the same words into mailbox kvrow,
        # whence a shared layer's S takes this launch's rows
        if const_expr(c["bf16_kv"]):
            words = [bf16_pair(v[0], v[1]), bf16_pair(v[2], v[3])]
            bo.buffer_store(
                fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
                rsrc(c["kv_cache"] + fx.Int64(slot) * (2 * KV_DIM)),
                2 * tid,
                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
            )
            put2(c["mb"]["kvrow"], s * kvw + 2 * tid, words[0], words[1], tag)
        else:
            word = fp8x4(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3])
            bo.buffer_store(word, rsrc(c["kv_cache"] + fx.Int64(slot) * KV_DIM), tid, cache_modifier=CM_DEV)
            put(c["mb"]["kvrow"], s * kvw + tid, word, tag)
    if const_expr(c["index"]):
        # the row out before its flag: an indexer layer's S reads it from the pool
        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        if tid == 0:
            put(c["mb"]["kv_done"], s, fx.Int32(1), tag)


@flyc.jit
def stage_q(c, t):
    """Task t's ABSORB_COLS columns of a head for every row (absorb: a wave 16 of them on MFMAs). Its weights load
    while it waits for q_nope."""
    tid, tag, err, s, lane = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"], c["s"], c["lane"]
    h, c0 = t // (KV_LORA // ABSORB_COLS), (t % (KV_LORA // ABSORB_COLS)) * ABSORB_COLS
    weights = absorb_weights(c["w_kc"], h, c0, lane, c["wave"])
    scale = ld_f32(c["w_scale"], 0)
    q_lds = c["lds"]
    # one wait for all: a thread past the pairs polls its first pair again
    n_q = -(-s * NOPE // 2 // THREADS)
    at = [fx.min(i * THREADS + tid, s * NOPE // 2 - 1) for i in range(n_q)]
    got = poll2n(c["mb"]["q"], [p // (NOPE // 2) * Q_B + h * HEAD_Q + p % (NOPE // 2) * 2 for p in at], tag, err)
    for i in range_constexpr(n_q):
        if i * THREADS + tid < s * NOPE // 2:
            r, k = at[i] // (NOPE // 2), at[i] % (NOPE // 2) * 2
            fx.ptr_store(_f32(got[i][0]), q_lds + r * NOPE + k)
            fx.ptr_store(_f32(got[i][1]), q_lds + r * NOPE + k + 1)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    vals = absorb(weights, q_lds, s, lane, scale)
    r = lane % 16
    if r < s:
        base = (r * HEADS + h) * KV_DIM + c0 + 16 * c["wave"] + 4 * (lane // 16)
        put2(c["mb"]["query"], base // 2, bf16_pair(vals[0], vals[1]), bf16_pair(vals[2], vals[3]), tag)


@flyc.jit
def stage_s(c, t):
    tid, tag, err, topk, groups = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"], c["topk"], c["s_groups"]
    n_parts = topk // PART
    # task t: head group t % groups of (row, part) t // groups
    t, group = t // groups, t % groups
    s, part = t // n_parts, t % n_parts
    first, pool = s * topk + part * PART, rsrc(c["kv_cache"])
    if const_expr(not c["index"]):
        # a shared layer's top-k is the launch's input: its rows load ahead of the waits, those this launch writes
        # (at its cache_locations) again once written
        slot = ld_i32(c["topk_indices"], first + tid % PART)
        ahead = rows_ahead(pool, lambda r: ld_i32(c["topk_indices"], first + r), tid, CM_DEV, c["bf16_kv"])
        news = [ld_i32(c["cache_locations"], j * 2) for j in range(c["s"])]
        # S's code (and the stages' after it) into L2 while the query is awaited, behind the rows' loads
        warm = warm_code(CODE_WARM)
        # the rows into LDS while the query is awaited (they need none)
        stage_rows(c["lds"], ahead, slot, tid, c["bf16_kv"])
        # then a row this launch writes (row j's cache_locations) over its staged words, from K's mailbox kvrow:
        # K's tasks end before Q's
        kvw = kv_words(c["bf16_kv"])
        for i in range_constexpr(len(ahead)):
            r, w, row_slot, _ = ahead[i]
            new, j_new = row_slot == news[0], fx.Int32(0)
            for j in range_constexpr(1, c["s"]):
                new, j_new = new | (row_slot == news[j]), (row_slot == news[j]).select(fx.Int32(j), j_new)
            if new:
                at = j_new * kvw + 4 * w
                kv_got = poll2n(c["mb"]["kvrow"], [at, at + 2], tag, err)
                store_row(c["lds"], r, w, [kv_got[0][0], kv_got[0][1], kv_got[1][0], kv_got[1][1]], c["bf16_kv"])
    # the query of the task's heads in bf16 pairs, where attn_part's LDS q holds them (a thread past the pairs polls
    # the last again): the other heads' scores come of stale words, and no softmax or PV of the task reads them
    n_pairs, g_pairs = HEADS * KV_DIM // 2, HEADS // groups * KV_DIM // 2
    at_q = [
        group * g_pairs + fx.min(i * THREADS + tid, g_pairs // 2 - 1) * 2 for i in range(-(-g_pairs // 2 // THREADS))
    ]
    got = poll2n(c["mb"]["query"], [s * n_pairs + a for a in at_q], tag, err)
    for i in range_constexpr(len(at_q)):
        if i * THREADS + tid < g_pairs // 2:
            for e in range_constexpr(2):
                fx.ptr_store(got[i][e].bitcast(fx.Float32), c["lds"] + at_q[i] + e)
    if const_expr(not c["index"]):
        hold(warm)
    if const_expr(c["index"]):
        if tid < c["s"]:
            poll1(c["mb"]["kv_done"], tid, tag, err)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if const_expr(c["index"]):
        # S's code (and the stages' after it) into L2 under the top-k's wait: past the barrier (which waits for every
        # load) and the query (an indexer layer's in by now; a wave's loads return in order)
        warm = warm_code(CODE_WARM)
        # the part's top-k slots, this launch's own (stage_tg's tagged copies in tk): whichever TG part wrote each
        slot = poll1(c["mb"]["tk"], first + tid % PART, tag, err)
        hold(warm)
    m, l_sum, o = attn_part(
        c["lds"], pool, slot, c["sm_scale"], tid, CM_DEV, c["bf16_kv"], group, groups, not c["index"]
    )
    box, base, ht = c["mb"]["partials"], t * PART_WORDS, HEADS // groups
    if tid == 0:
        for i in range_constexpr(ht):
            put2(box, base + 2 * (group * ht + i), _bits(m[i]), _bits(l_sum[i]), tag)
    # a lane's word and its odd neighbour's (the next word) in one 16-byte put from the even lane
    outs = part_out(o, tid, group, groups)
    for j in range_constexpr(len(outs)):
        h, w, word, held = outs[j]
        nxt = xshfl(word, 1)
        if held & (tid % 2 == 0):
            put2(box, base + 2 * HEADS + h * (KV_LORA // 2) + w, word, nxt, tag)


@flyc.jit
def stage_t(c, t):
    """Task t: half t % 2 of head t // 2 % HEADS's columns of row t // (2 HEADS) (attn_head): the parts merged,
    w_vc, quantized into mailboxes hq (a 128-group) and hs."""
    tid, tag, err = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"]
    n_parts = c["topk"] // PART
    s, h, half = t // (2 * HEADS), t // 2 % HEADS, t % 2
    box = c["mb"]["partials"]
    ahead = vc_ahead(c["w_vc"], h, half, tid)
    # one wait for all: a part's m and l polled by one thread (the others poll their first o pairs twice)
    q = tid % (THREADS // 2)
    o_at = [(s * n_parts + p) * PART_WORDS + 2 * HEADS + h * (KV_LORA // 2) + 2 * q for p in head_parts(tid, n_parts)]
    ml_at = (tid < n_parts).select((s * n_parts + tid) * PART_WORDS + 2 * h, o_at[0])
    got = poll2n(box, [ml_at] + o_at, tag, err, batch=len(o_at) + 1)
    if tid < n_parts:
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(got[0][0]), head_ml(c["lds"], tid))
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(got[0][1]), head_ml(c["lds"], tid) + 1)
    o4 = [bf16_values(w0) + bf16_values(w1) for w0, w1 in got[1:]]
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    out = attn_head(o4, c["lds"], ld_f32(c["w_scale"], 0), tid, n_parts, ahead)
    if tid < V_HALF // 4:
        # o_proj's input: the task's 128-group in E4M3 at a scale of its amax / 448, as fp8_linear's, 32 threads
        # a group, into mailboxes hq and hs
        n = s * O_COLS + h * V_DIM + half * V_HALF + 4 * tid
        quantize_group4([bf16(out[e]) for e in range(4)], c["mb"]["hq"], c["mb"]["hs"], n, tag=tag)


@flyc.jit
def stage_o(c, t):
    """o_proj's groups O_GROUPS t .. + O_GROUPS - 1 on every head's quantized output (stage_t's), then the
    stream: each rank's hidden_states + the group's sums, by the columns' owner (rank t % tp) into that rank's
    peer buffer, every rank's hidden_states of the columns put to the owner first (exchange 2). Its first weights
    load while it waits."""
    groups = [O_GROUPS * t + g for g in range(O_GROUPS)]
    rows = (c["wave"] < O_GROUPS) & (c["col"] < c["s"])
    n = c["col"] * HIDDEN + (O_GROUPS * t + c["wave"]) * 16 + (c["lane"] // 16) * 4
    owner = t % c["tp"]
    # the residual's loads ahead of the weights' (a wave's loads return in order), so that its put waits for them
    # alone: at the owner long before the group's sums
    hw = [ld_i32(c["hidden_states"], rows.select(n, fx.Int32(0)) // 2 + m) for m in range(2)]
    ahead = gemv_split_ahead(c["o_weight"], c["o_scale"], O_COLS, groups, c["lane"], c["wave"])
    if rows:
        _put2_to(c, 2, n, hw, owner)
    x_lds = _x_polled(c, c["mb"]["hq"], c["mb"]["hs"], O_COLS)
    w, sw, lane, wave = c["o_weight"], c["o_scale"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
    accs = gemv_split(w, sw, None, None, O_COLS, groups, lane, wave, c["lds"], ahead=ahead, x_lds=x_lds)
    # wave g finishes group g
    acc = accs[0]
    for g in range_constexpr(1, O_GROUPS):
        acc = [(c["wave"] == g).select(a, b) for a, b in zip(accs[g], acc)]
    if rows:
        # the group's sum reduce-scattered: task t's columns summed on rank t % tp, which puts each rank's stream
        # into its peer buffer (a quarter of an all-to-all's bytes over XGMI)
        _group_put4_to(c, 0, n, acc, owner)
        if c["rank"] == owner:
            total, residuals = _o_sums(c, n)
            for p in range_constexpr(c["tp"]):
                hidden = bf16_values(residuals[p][0]) + bf16_values(residuals[p][1])
                # rank p's residual stream in bf16, as SGLang's: a pair a word, half the bytes its readers poll
                stream = [hidden[e] + total[e] for e in range(4)]
                words = [bf16_pair(stream[0], stream[1]), bf16_pair(stream[2], stream[3])]
                put2(c["peers"][p], c["sbase"] + n // 2, words[0], words[1], c["tag"], CM_SYS)


def _poll_stream_row(c, s):
    """Row s of the stream (bf16 pairs), the thread's 8 values a pass: (p * THREADS + tid) * 8 .. + 7 for pass p."""
    base = c["sbase"] + s * HIDDEN // 2
    got = poll2n(
        c["own"],
        [base + (p * THREADS + c["tid"]) * 4 + 2 * m for p in range(PASSES) for m in range(2)],
        c["tag"],
        c["err"],
        CM_SYS,
    )
    return [[v for pair in got[2 * p : 2 * p + 2] for w in pair for v in bf16_values(w)] for p in range(PASSES)]


def _rmsnorm_values(c, values):
    """RMSNorm of a row's values (``_poll_stream_row``'s), in f32: x, the thread's 8 a pass."""
    sq = sum((e * e for v in values for e in v), fx.Float32(0.0))
    inv = rsq(block_reduce(sq, c["lds"], c["tid"], add) / HIDDEN + c["eps"])
    x = []
    for p in range_constexpr(PASSES):
        g = load_bf16x8(c["post_norm_weight"], (p * THREADS + c["tid"]) * 8)
        x.append([values[p][e] * inv * g[e] for e in range(8)])
    return x


def _block_sums(c, values, at):
    """Each of values summed over the workgroup in block_reduce's order (a wave's xor halving, then the waves in
    turn), in every thread; at: LDS for WAVES * len(values) f32. A power of two of them by spread_reduce (the
    same sums: a lane's value l // (64 / n)'s, which its lanes store alike)."""
    n = len(values)
    if const_expr(n > 1 and n & (n - 1) == 0):
        fx.ptr_store(spread_reduce(values, add), at + c["lane"] // (64 // n) * WAVES + c["wave"])
    else:
        sums = xor_reduce_all(values, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), add)
        for i in range_constexpr(n):
            fx.ptr_store(sums[i], at + i * WAVES + c["wave"])
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    out = []
    for i in range_constexpr(len(values)):
        total = fx.ptr_load(at + i * WAVES)
        for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
            total = total + fx.ptr_load(at + i * WAVES + w)
        out.append(total)
    return out


@flyc.jit
def stage_m1(c, t):
    """Row t // per of the stream normalized by post_attention_layernorm (per = m1_tasks // s workgroups a row); the
    row's router logits of experts part * n .. + n - 1 (part = t % per, n = ceil(N_ROUTED / per)) into mailbox
    logits: a thread's products over its columns, then summed over the workgroup. The row's 1x128 blocks kb with
    kb % per = part in E4M3: up to UG_ROWS rows into mailboxes xq8 and xs8 ahead of the logits, above into the
    shared mq and ms at device scope, then the task's flag in m1_done."""
    tid, tag, per = c["tid"], c["tag"], m1_tasks(c["s"]) // c["s"]
    n = -(-N_ROUTED // per)
    row, part = t // per, t % per
    cols = [(p * THREADS + tid) * 8 for p in range(PASSES)]
    # the router rows (bf16 pairs; past the experts, the last's) and gamma ahead of the stream's polls
    rows_at = [fx.min(part * n + j, fx.Int32(N_ROUTED - 1)) * HIDDEN for j in range(n)]
    words = [
        [fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(c["router_weight"], (e + k) // 2, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32)) for k in cols]
        for e in rows_at
    ]
    gamma = [load_bf16x8(c["post_norm_weight"], k) for k in cols]
    # a logit is the row's rstd times the router row dotted with v * gamma (moe.router_launcher's order), so a pass's
    # dots and squares need only its own values: every pass's stream pairs issued now, each pass taken once its own
    # loads return (a wave's loads return in order) while the later passes' are in flight
    pairs = [[c["sbase"] + (row * HIDDEN + k) // 2 + 2 * m for m in range(2)] for k in cols]
    issued = [issue2n(c["own"], at, CM_SYS) for at in pairs]
    vals, sq, parts = [], fx.Float32(0.0), [fx.Float32(0.0)] * n
    for p in range_constexpr(PASSES):
        got = poll_issued([c["own"]] * 2, pairs[p], issued[p], c["tag"], c["err"], CM_SYS)
        v = [x for pair in got for wd in pair for x in bf16_values(wd)]
        vals.append(v)
        sq = sum((e * e for e in v), sq)
        vg = [v[e] * gamma[p][e] for e in range(8)]
        for j in range_constexpr(n):
            w = [x for k in range(4) for x in bf16_values(words[j][p][k])]
            # fused multiply-adds: two pack into one v_pk_fma_f32
            for e in range_constexpr(8):
                parts[j] = fmath.fma(vg[e], w[e], parts[j])
    sums = _block_sums(c, parts + [sq] + [fx.Float32(0.0)] * ((1 << n.bit_length()) - n - 1), c["lds"])
    inv = rsq(sums[n] / HIDDEN + c["eps"])
    logits = [sums[j] * inv for j in range(n)]
    if (tid < n) & (part * n + tid < N_ROUTED):
        put(c["mb"]["logits"], row * N_ROUTED + part * n + tid, _bits(bf16(_pick(logits, tid))), tag)
    x = [[v[e] * inv * g[e] for e in range(8)] for v, g in zip(vals, gamma)]
    if const_expr(c["s"] <= UG_ROWS):
        # UG's x out behind the logits (its routing waits for them; its jobs, for x after the routing)
        for p in range_constexpr(PASSES):
            if (p * (THREADS // 16) + tid // 16) % per == part:
                quantize_group([bf16(v) for v in x[p]], c["mb"]["xq8"], c["mb"]["xs8"], row, HIDDEN, cols[p], tag=tag)
    if const_expr(c["s"] > UG_ROWS):
        # block kb is pass kb // 16's, on its threads 16 (kb % 16) .. + 15
        mq, ms = rsrc(c["scratch"] + c["off"]["mq"]), rsrc(c["scratch"] + c["off"]["ms"])
        for p in range_constexpr(PASSES):
            if (p * (THREADS // 16) + tid // 16) % per == part:
                quantize_group([bf16(v) for v in x[p]], mq, ms, row, HIDDEN, cols[p], CM_DEV)
        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        if tid == 0:
            put(c["mb"]["m1_done"], t, fx.Int32(1), tag)


def _key_bits(k):
    """An f32 key's bits as an i32 in the floats' order (no -0 among sigmoid + bias keys)."""
    b = k.bitcast(fx.Int32)
    return (b >= 0).select(b, b ^ fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF))


def _top8_start(keys, idxs, scores):
    """_top8_rounds' state of a row: each lane's 4 (key bits, idx, score) sorted, the higher key first, the lower idx
    among equals, then one below every key. A lane's idxs are all below the next lane's."""
    ks, ids, scs = [_key_bits(k) for k in keys], list(idxs), list(scores)
    assert len(ks) == 4
    for a, b in ((0, 1), (2, 3), (0, 2), (1, 3), (1, 2)):
        first = (ks[a] > ks[b]) | ((ks[a] == ks[b]) & (ids[a] < ids[b]))
        ks[a], ks[b] = first.select(ks[a], ks[b]), first.select(ks[b], ks[a])
        ids[a], ids[b] = first.select(ids[a], ids[b]), first.select(ids[b], ids[a])
        scs[a], scs[b] = first.select(scs[a], scs[b]), first.select(scs[b], scs[a])
    return [ks + [fx.Int32(-(2**31))], ids + [fx.Int32(N_ROUTED)], scs + [fx.Float32(0.0)]]


def _top8_rounds(state, n):
    """The wave's next n highest keys, the lower idx first among equals: (key bits, idx, score) a pick, every
    lane's, and the state past them. A round takes the wave's highest head by a reduction in registers, the
    lowest lane's among equal ones (so the lowest idx), and that lane pops it."""
    ks, ids, scs = state
    imax = lambda a, b: (a > b).select(a, b)  # noqa: E731
    lane_of = fx.thread_idx.x % 64
    picks = []
    for _ in range_constexpr(n):
        m = xor_reduce(ks[0], (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), imax)
        ballot = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, ks[0] == m))
        src = fx.Int32(fx.ctpop((ballot & (fx.Int64(0) - ballot)) - fx.Int64(1)))
        hit = fx.Int32(lane_of) == src
        win = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, ids[0], src))
        sc = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, scs[0].bitcast(fx.Int32), src)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
        picks.append((m, win, sc))
        ks = [hit.select(ks[i + 1], ks[i]) for i in range(4)] + [ks[4]]
        ids = [hit.select(ids[i + 1], ids[i]) for i in range(4)] + [ids[4]]
        scs = [hit.select(scs[i + 1], scs[i]) for i in range(4)] + [scs[4]]
    return picks, [ks, ids, scs]


@flyc.jit
def _route_start(c, rounds):
    """The first ``rounds`` of every row's top 8 experts by sigmoid(logit) + bias (_route_end's), row r's by wave
    r % WAVES, into _expert_lds' ids (pick k of row r at r * SLOTS + k): (the rows' top-8 states, their picks so
    far), every one of the wave's rows' at once (past the rows, the last row's again)."""
    lane, tag = c["lane"], c["tag"]
    ids = _expert_lds(c)[0]
    idxs = [4 * lane + k for k in range(4)]
    # the biases ahead of the logits' wait; one wait for all of the wave's rows (past the rows, the last row's again)
    bias = [ld_f32(c["correction_bias"], i) for i in idxs]
    n_r = -(-c["s"] // WAVES)
    rows = [fx.min(j * WAVES + c["wave"], c["s"] - 1) for j in range(n_r)]
    at = [rows[j] * N_ROUTED + 4 * lane + 2 * h for j in range(n_r) for h in range(2)]
    got_all = poll2n(c["mb"]["logits"], at, tag, c["err"])
    states, picks = [], []
    for j in range_constexpr(n_r):
        scores = [sigmoid(_f32(got_all[2 * j + h][e])) for h in range(2) for e in range(2)]
        got_picks, state = _top8_rounds(_top8_start([sc + b for sc, b in zip(scores, bias)], idxs, scores), rounds)
        states.append(state)
        picks.append(got_picks)
    if const_expr(rounds > 0):
        for j in range_constexpr(n_r):
            row = j * WAVES + c["wave"]
            e = _pick([i for _, i, _ in picks[j]], lane)
            if (row < c["s"]) & (lane < rounds):
                fx.ptr_store(_f32(e), ids + row * SLOTS + lane)
    return states, picks


@flyc.jit
def _route_end(c, states, picks, rounds):
    """_route_start's rows' last TOPK - ``rounds`` picks: every row's top 8 experts, the lower expert first among
    equals, into _expert_lds' ids, the shared expert (N_ROUTED) in a row's last slot, and their weights into its
    weights (the 8's scores over their sum times the scaling, then 1)."""
    lane = c["lane"]
    ids, weights = _expert_lds(c)[0], _expert_lds(c)[5]
    all_picks = [picks[j] + _top8_rounds(states[j], TOPK - rounds)[0] for j in range(len(states))]
    for j in range_constexpr(len(states)):
        row = j * WAVES + c["wave"]
        if row < c["s"]:
            row_picks = all_picks[j]
            e = _pick([i for _, i, _ in row_picks] + [fx.Int32(N_ROUTED)], lane)
            total = row_picks[0][2]
            for r in range_constexpr(1, TOPK):
                total = total + row_picks[r][2]
            sc = _pick([p[2] for p in row_picks], lane)
            weight = (lane < TOPK).select(div_rn(sc, total) * c["scaling"], fx.Float32(1.0))
            if lane < SLOTS:
                fx.ptr_store(_f32(e), ids + row * SLOTS + lane)
                fx.ptr_store(weight, weights + row * SLOTS + lane)


@flyc.jit
def _route(c):
    """Every row's top 8 experts and their weights, in one go: _route_start's with no pick, then _route_end's."""
    states, picks = _route_start(c, 0)
    _route_end(c, states, picks, 0)


def _expert_lds(c):
    """The MoE's LDS arrays at the end of the workgroup's: _unique_experts' (ids, an expert's unique index,
    counts, uniq, table), then _route's weights."""
    n = c["s"] * SLOTS
    ids = c["lds"] + c["lds_words"] - n
    u_of = ids - N_ROUTED
    counts = u_of - 8
    uniq = counts - n
    table = uniq - n * c["s"]
    return ids, u_of, counts, uniq, table, table - n


@flyc.jit
def _unique_experts(c):
    """The rows' experts (_route's ids), each once, the routed ones by id, then the shared one: uniq[u] the u-th's
    id and table[u * s + r] the (row, slot) of row r choosing it (-1: none), in LDS; their count, wave-uniform.
    A thread an expert: a flag each chosen one, then its index from the waves' ballots."""
    tid, s, lane, wave = c["tid"], c["s"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
    assert THREADS == N_ROUTED
    n = s * SLOTS
    ids, u_of, counts, uniq, table = _expert_lds(c)[:5]
    for i in range_constexpr(-(-n * s // THREADS)):
        if tid + i * THREADS < n * s:
            fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(-1)), table + tid + i * THREADS)
    fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(0)), u_of + tid)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if tid < n:
        e = _bits(fx.ptr_load(ids + tid))
        if e < N_ROUTED:
            fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(1)), u_of + e)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    chosen = _bits(fx.ptr_load(u_of + tid)) != 0
    mask = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, chosen))
    below = fx.Int32(fx.ctpop(mask & ((fx.Int64(1) << fx.Int64(lane)) - fx.Int64(1))))
    if lane == 0:
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(fx.ctpop(mask))), counts + wave)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    before, total = fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(0)
    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
        k = _bits(fx.ptr_load(counts + w))
        before = before + (fx.Int32(w) < wave).select(k, fx.Int32(0))
        total = total + k
    u = before + below
    if chosen:
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(tid)), uniq + u)
    fx.ptr_store(_f32(u), u_of + tid)
    if tid == 0:
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(N_ROUTED)), uniq + total)
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(total + 1), counts + WAVES)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if tid < n:
        e = _bits(fx.ptr_load(ids + tid))
        u_e = (e < N_ROUTED).select(_bits(fx.ptr_load(u_of + fx.min(e, N_ROUTED - 1))), total)
        fx.ptr_store(_f32(fx.Int32(tid)), table + u_e * s + tid // SLOTS)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    return _unique_count(c)


def _unique_count(c):
    """_unique_experts' count, from LDS, wave-uniform."""
    return uniform(_bits(fx.ptr_load(_expert_lds(c)[2] + WAVES)))


def _expert_rows(c, u):
    """Of unique expert u, the (row, slot) of the lane's sample's row (-1: the row does not choose it, or no
    such row)."""
    table = _expert_lds(c)[4]
    col = fx.Int32(c["col"])
    sj = _bits(fx.ptr_load(table + u * c["s"] + (col < c["s"]).select(col, fx.Int32(0))))
    return (col < c["s"]).select(sj, fx.Int32(-1))


def _gu_unit(c, f):
    """M2's unit f: (its weight groups, its _unique_experts index, shared). Units 0 .. GU_TILES - 1 are the shared
    expert's gate groups j with up groups j + GU_UNITS, then each routed expert's in _unique_experts' order (the
    shared one, last there, skipped)."""
    shared = f < GU_TILES
    q = fx.max(f - GU_TILES, fx.Int32(0))
    u = q // GU_TILES
    e = shared.select(fx.Int32(N_ROUTED), _bits(fx.ptr_load(_expert_lds(c)[3] + u)))
    j = shared.select(f, q % GU_TILES)
    return [e * (GATE_UP // 16) + j, e * (GATE_UP // 16) + GU_UNITS + j], j, u, shared


def _expert_rows_at(c, u, col):
    """_expert_rows' of sample ``col``."""
    sj = _bits(fx.ptr_load(_expert_lds(c)[4] + u * c["s"] + (col < c["s"]).select(col, fx.Int32(0))))
    return (col < c["s"]).select(sj, fx.Int32(-1))


def _down_unit(c, i, n_u, t):
    """M3's unit i of workgroup t: below n_u, unique expert i on the full 16-row group (_down_groups'); then
    experts 2v and 2v + 1 (v = i - n_u) on the half group's 8 rows, one MFMA: A rows 0-7 and samples 0-7 the
    first's, rows 8-15 and samples 8-15 the second's. (gemv_lanes' unit, (full, the lane's (row, slot) of the
    expert of its column, -1: none, live)); past the units, of no bytes and no (row, slot)."""
    lane, col = c["lane"], fx.Int32(c["col"])
    full_g, half_g, lo = _down_groups(t)
    n_units = n_u + (n_u + 1) // 2
    live = i < n_units
    full, packed = i < n_u, i >= n_u
    v = fx.max(i - n_u, fx.Int32(0))
    u_a = fx.min(full.select(i, 2 * v), n_u - 1)
    u_b = fx.min(2 * v + 1, n_u - 1)
    has_b = 2 * v + 1 < n_u
    uniq = _expert_lds(c)[3]
    e_a, e_b = _bits(fx.ptr_load(uniq + u_a)), _bits(fx.ptr_load(uniq + u_b))
    group = full.select(fx.Int32(full_g), half_g)
    r = lane % 16
    e_w = (packed & (r >= 8)).select(e_b, e_a)
    e_s = (packed & (lane // 16 >= 2)).select(e_b, e_a)
    w_ln = full.select(lane, lane - r + lo + (r & 7))
    side_x = packed & (col >= 8)
    sj = _expert_rows_at(c, side_x.select(u_b, u_a), side_x.select(col - 8, col))
    sj = (live & (full | (col < 8) | has_b)).select(sj, fx.Int32(-1))
    n = c["s"] * SLOTS
    nbytes = uniform(live.select(fx.Int32(W2_BYTES), fx.Int32(0)))
    sbytes = uniform(live.select(fx.Int32(W2_SCALE_BYTES), fx.Int32(0)))
    unit = (
        (c["w2"], nbytes),
        (c["w2_scale"], sbytes),
        e_w * (HIDDEN // 16) + group,
        w_ln,
        e_s * (HIDDEN // 16) + group,
        (sj >= 0).select(sj, fx.Int32(n - 1)),
    )
    return unit, (full, sj)


def _down_groups(t):
    """Workgroup t's M3 rows: (its full 16-row group, its half group, the half's first row in it)."""
    odd = t % 2
    return 3 * (t // 2) + 2 * odd, 3 * (t // 2) + 1, 8 * odd


def _w1(c, live):
    """w1's resources, of no bytes where not ``live``: their loads read 0 without a memory access."""
    return (
        rsrc(c["w1"], live.select(fx.Int32(W1_BYTES), fx.Int32(0))),
        rsrc(c["w1_scale"], live.select(fx.Int32(W1_SCALE_BYTES), fx.Int32(0))),
    )


def _gu_gemv(c, groups, x_lds, ahead):
    """A gate_up unit (_gu_unit's groups) on x_lds: gemv_split's (gate, up), every wave's."""
    w, sw = rsrc(c["w1"]), rsrc(c["w1_scale"])
    return gemv_split(w, sw, None, None, HIDDEN, groups, c["lane"], c["wave"], c["lds"], 0, ahead, x_lds)


@flyc.jit
def _gu_out(c, gate_up, j, sj):
    """A gate_up unit's outputs (gemv_split's, every wave's): silu(gate) * up rounded to bf16 of gate group j into
    mailbox h at (row, slot) sj (-1: none), by wave 0."""
    lane = c["lane"]
    gate, up = gate_up
    if (c["wave"] == 0) & (sj >= 0):
        k = j * 16 + (lane // 16) * 4
        h = [bf16(gate[r] * sigmoid(gate[r]) * up[r]) for r in range(4)]
        put2(c["mb"]["h"], (sj * INTER + k) // 2, bf16_pair(h[0], h[1]), bf16_pair(h[2], h[3]), c["tag"])


@flyc.jit
def stage_m2(c, t):
    """Every row's top 8 experts (_route) and the rows' experts each once (_unique_experts), once every row's
    logits are in; then gate_up of the task's units (_gu_unit) on x (mq and ms copied into LDS), a
    unit in one gemv_split call (the waves a quarter of K each), into mailbox h (_gu_out). Units t, t + CTAS, ..:
    the shared expert's on workgroups 0 .. GU_TILES - 1, their weights issued before the routing (the workgroups
    whose units are one more, when the units are 8 s + 1 experts')."""
    s, lane, wave = c["s"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
    shared_groups = _gu_unit(c, fx.min(t, GU_TILES - 1))[0]
    early = gemv_split_ahead(*_w1(c, t < GU_TILES), HIDDEN, shared_groups, lane, wave)
    _route(c)
    n_units = _unique_experts(c) * GU_TILES
    # a routed first unit's weights before x's wait
    first = _gu_unit(c, fx.min(t, n_units - 1))[0]
    late = gemv_split_ahead(*_w1(c, (t >= GU_TILES) & (t < n_units)), HIDDEN, first, lane, wave)
    if c["tid"] < CTAS // s * s:
        poll1(c["mb"]["m1_done"], c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"])
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    # x copied into LDS once, read there at each block's MFMAs
    x_lds = _x_copied(c, rsrc(c["scratch"] + c["off"]["mq"]), rsrc(c["scratch"] + c["off"]["ms"]), HIDDEN)
    shared_sj = (c["col"] < s).select(c["col"] * SLOTS + TOPK, fx.Int32(-1))
    for i in range_constexpr(-(-s * SLOTS * GU_TILES // CTAS)):
        f = t + CTAS * i
        if f < n_units:
            groups, j, u, shared = _gu_unit(c, f)
            if const_expr(i == 0):
                if shared:
                    _gu_out(c, _gu_gemv(c, groups, x_lds, early), j, shared_sj)
                else:
                    _gu_out(c, _gu_gemv(c, groups, x_lds, late), j, _expert_rows(c, u))
            else:
                _gu_out(c, _gu_gemv(c, groups, x_lds, ()), j, _expert_rows(c, u))


@flyc.jit
def stage_m3(c, t):
    """down: h's rows ((row, slot)s) in E4M3 per 128 into the workgroup's LDS (from mailbox h); then the task's
    DOWN_ROWS output rows of every expert on its rows' h. Workgroups 2j and 2j + 1 split 16-row groups 3j ..
    3j + 2, the even one group 3j and rows 0-7 of 3j + 1, the odd one rows 8-15 of 3j + 1 and group 3j + 2:
    _down_unit's units, every expert's full group then two experts' halves a unit, wave w's w, w + WAVES, .. Then
    each row's slots weighed and summed in order, the group's sums, plus the stream: the layer's out."""
    tid, lane, wave, s, tag = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["s"], c["tag"]
    n = s * SLOTS
    full_g, half_g, lo = _down_groups(t)
    n_u, eo = _unique_count(c), c["lds"]
    per_wave = -(-(n + (n + 1) // 2) // WAVES)
    # the first chunk's weights before h
    first = [_down_unit(c, wave + WAVES * kc, n_u, t) for kc in range(min(DOWN_CHUNK, per_wave))]
    ahead = gemv_lanes_ahead(INTER, [u for u, _ in first])
    dq, stride, ds = _m3_h(c)
    # one wait for all, the stream's 4 values of the end's sums too: a thread past the rows polls its first 8
    # values again, past the sums' threads the last's stream values
    n_h = -(-n * (INTER // 8) // THREADS)
    at = [fx.min(i * THREADS + tid, n * (INTER // 8) - 1) * 8 for i in range(n_h)]
    q_at = fx.min(tid, s * (DOWN_ROWS // 4) - 1)
    k_at = q_at // (DOWN_ROWS // 4) * HIDDEN + t * DOWN_ROWS + 4 * (q_at % (DOWN_ROWS // 4))
    got = poll2n(
        [c["own"]] + [c["mb"]["h"]] * (2 * n_h),
        [c["sbase"] + k_at // 2] + [a // 2 + 2 * m for a in at for m in range(2)],
        tag,
        c["err"],
        CM_SYS,
        batch=1 + 2 * n_h,
    )
    stream, got = got[:1], got[1:]
    for i in range_constexpr(n_h):
        if i * THREADS + tid < n * (INTER // 8):
            words = [w for pair in got[2 * i : 2 * i + 2] for w in pair]
            row, k0 = at[i] // INTER, at[i] % INTER
            quantize_group_lds([v for w in words for v in bf16_values(w)], dq, stride, ds, row, INTER, k0)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    n_units = n_u + (n_u + 1) // 2
    for c0 in range_constexpr(0, per_wave, DOWN_CHUNK):
        if wave + WAVES * c0 < n_units:
            chunk = range(c0, min(c0 + DOWN_CHUNK, per_wave))
            units = first if c0 == 0 else [_down_unit(c, wave + WAVES * kc, n_u, t) for kc in chunk]
            accs = gemv_lanes(INTER, [u for u, _ in units], lane, (dq, stride, ds, n), ahead if c0 == 0 else ())
            for k in range_constexpr(len(units)):
                full, sj = units[k][1]
                for r in range_constexpr(4):
                    rr = (lane // 16) * 4 + r
                    # a packed unit's sums: the lanes whose rows and column are one expert's
                    row_at = full.select(full_g * 16 + rr, half_g * 16 + lo + (rr & 7)) - t * DOWN_ROWS
                    own = full | ((rr >= 8) & (c["col"] >= 8)) | ((rr < 8) & (c["col"] < 8))
                    if (sj >= 0) & own:
                        fx.ptr_store(accs[k][r], eo + sj * DOWN_ROWS + row_at)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if tid < s * (DOWN_ROWS // 4):
        row, q = tid // (DOWN_ROWS // 4), tid % (DOWN_ROWS // 4)
        weights = _expert_lds(c)[5]
        acc = [fx.Float32(0.0)] * 4
        for j in range_constexpr(SLOTS):
            w_j = fx.ptr_load(weights + row * SLOTS + j)
            for r in range_constexpr(4):
                acc[r] = acc[r] + w_j * fx.ptr_load(eo + (row * SLOTS + j) * DOWN_ROWS + 4 * q + r)
        k0 = row * HIDDEN + t * DOWN_ROWS + 4 * q
        total = _group_sum4(c, 1, k0, acc)
        sv = bf16_values(stream[0][0]) + bf16_values(stream[0][1])
        outs = [sv[r] + total[r] for r in range(4)]
        bo.buffer_store(
            fx.Vector.from_elements([bf16_pair(outs[0], outs[1]), bf16_pair(outs[2], outs[3])], fx.Int32),
            c["out"],
            k0 // 2,
        )


UG8 = 8  # UG's intermediates a tile: 8 gate and their 8 up rows, one MFMA's 16
UG_TPE = INTER // UG8  # an expert's tiles
UG_BLOCKS = HIDDEN // 128 // WAVES  # a UG job's 128-k blocks a wave: the waves a quarter of K each
UG_FIRST = 8  # the first job's blocks a wave issued before the rest of the routing (a multiple of 4)
DN_GROUPS = 2  # the 16-row groups a DN task's DOWN_ROWS rows touch
DN_WPG = WAVES // DN_GROUPS  # DN's waves a group
DN_AHEAD = 30  # DN's units a wave in flight (2 vector loads each, their scale a scalar's): most of down's weights
# out before h is in


def _ug_job(c, e, tile, live):
    """A UG job's gemv_lanes unit: tile ``tile`` (intermediates 8 tile .. + 7) of expert e, gate rows on A rows 0-7
    and their up rows on 8-15; its sums' columns the samples (x_lds rows). Of no bytes where not ``live``."""
    lane = c["lane"]
    r = lane % 16
    g_lane = (r >= 8).select(fx.Int32(GU_UNITS), fx.Int32(0)) + tile // 2
    g_out = (lane // 16 >= 2).select(fx.Int32(GU_UNITS), fx.Int32(0)) + tile // 2
    w_ln = (lane - r) + (tile % 2) * 8 + (r & 7)
    nbytes = uniform(live.select(fx.Int32(W1_BYTES), fx.Int32(0)))
    sbytes = uniform(live.select(fx.Int32(W1_SCALE_BYTES), fx.Int32(0)))
    return (
        (c["w1"], nbytes),
        (c["w1_scale"], sbytes),
        e * (GATE_UP // 16) + g_lane,
        w_ln,
        e * (GATE_UP // 16) + g_out,
        fx.min(fx.Int32(c["col"]), fx.Int32(c["s"] - 1)),
    )


def _ug_issue(job, kb0, first=0, count=UG_BLOCKS):
    """A UG job's weight loads of the wave's blocks first .. first + count - 1 (of UG_BLOCKS from kb0), issued now
    (gemv_lanes' ahead), the lane's scales of them 4 a load."""
    (w, w_bytes), (sw, sw_bytes), wg, w_ln, sg, _ = job
    w, sw = rsrc(w, w_bytes), rsrc(sw, sw_bytes)
    base = sg // 8 * (HIDDEN // 128) + kb0 + first
    scales = [ld_f32(sw, base + 4 * i, 4) for i in range(-(-count // 4))]
    out = []
    for b in range(count):
        kb = kb0 + first + b
        at = [((wg * (HIDDEN // 64) + cc) * 64 + w_ln) * 4 for cc in (2 * kb, 2 * kb + 1)]
        ws = [bo.buffer_load(w, a, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=NT) for a in at]
        out.append((ws, scales[b // 4][b % 4]))
    return out


def _ug_owns(c, es, keys, span):
    """Whether each expert of ``es`` is owned by the job of its key (job index * s + row): of the (row, pick)s
    choosing it, the one of the lowest job index (pick // span), then the lowest row, its job streaming it for every
    row choosing it (the others' load nothing). Wave-uniform; the experts' reductions interleaved."""
    s, lane = c["s"], c["lane"]
    n = s * TOPK
    p = fx.min(lane, fx.Int32(n - 1))
    e_p = _bits(fx.ptr_load(_expert_lds(c)[0] + p // TOPK * SLOTS + p % TOPK))
    k_p = [((lane < n) & (e_p == e)).select(p % TOPK // span * s + p // TOPK, fx.Int32(1 << 20)) for e in es]
    imin = lambda a, b: (a < b).select(a, b)  # noqa: E731
    return [k == key for k, key in zip(xor_reduce_all(k_p, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), imin), keys)]


@flyc.jit
def _ug_emit(c, accs, tile, mine, slot):
    """A UG job's sums (gemv_lanes', the wave's quarter of K): summed over the waves in turn, then silu(gate) * up
    rounded to bf16 for tile ``tile`` into mailbox h at (the lane's sample, ``slot``) where ``mine`` (the lane's),
    by wave 0's lanes of gate rows."""
    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
    red = c["lds"]
    for e in range_constexpr(4):
        fx.ptr_store(accs[e], red + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4 + e)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    total = []
    for e in range_constexpr(4):
        v = fx.ptr_load(red + lane * 4 + e)
        for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
            v = v + fx.ptr_load(red + (w * 64 + lane) * 4 + e)
        total.append(v)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    up = [xshfl(v, 32) for v in total]
    col = fx.Int32(c["col"])
    if (wave == 0) & (lane < 32) & mine:
        sj = col * SLOTS + slot
        k = tile * UG8 + (lane // 16) * 4
        h = [bf16(total[r] * sigmoid(total[r]) * up[r]) for r in range(4)]
        put2(c["mb"]["h"], (sj * INTER + k) // 2, bf16_pair(h[0], h[1]), bf16_pair(h[2], h[3]), c["tag"])


@flyc.jit
def stage_ug(c, t):
    """gate_up in tiles of 8 intermediates (_ug_job), a job's K a quarter a wave, on x polled into LDS (M1's
    mailboxes): workgroup t < UG_TPE the shared expert's tile t for every sample (its weights issued first), ahead
    of every row's top 8 experts (_route, once every row's logits are in); then every workgroup one routed task:
    slot k = q // UG_TPE's tile q % UG_TPE (q = t + CTAS - UG_TPE below UG_TPE, else t - UG_TPE) of each
    sample's expert there in turn, the next one's weights issued while one is summed (no dedup: an expert
    several samples took streams once each)."""
    s, lane, wave = c["s"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
    kb0 = wave * UG_BLOCKS
    shared = t < UG_TPE
    sh_job = _ug_job(c, fx.Int32(N_ROUTED), fx.min(t, UG_TPE - 1), shared)
    early = _ug_issue(sh_job, kb0)
    # x (M1's mailboxes, out ahead of its logits) into LDS: on the shared tiles' workgroups first, for their tile
    # while the logits are summed; on the others behind the first job's weights, its round trip under their flight
    xq, xs = c["mb"]["xq8"], c["mb"]["xs8"]
    words, _, scales = _m2_x(c)
    x_lds = (words, X_STRIDE, scales, s)
    col = fx.Int32(c["col"])
    # the workgroups with no M1 task (from 2 rows) and the shared tiles' stage x before the routing
    early_x = shared | (t < CTAS - m1_tasks(s))
    if early_x:
        _x_polled(c, xq, xs, HIDDEN)
    if shared:
        _ug_emit(c, gemv_lanes(HIDDEN, [sh_job], lane, x_lds, early, kb0, UG_BLOCKS)[0], t, col < s, TOPK)
    ids = _expert_lds(c)[0]
    if const_expr(TOPK % s == 0):
        # a workgroup one row's tile of every span-th pick: its first job needs the row's first span picks only
        span = TOPK // s
        grp, tile = t // UG_TPE, t % UG_TPE
        row, pick0 = grp % s, grp // s
        states, picks = _route_start(c, span)
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        es = [_bits(fx.ptr_load(ids + row * SLOTS + pick0))]
        jobs = [_ug_job(c, es[0], tile, fx.Int32(1) > 0)]
        # the first job's first weights, the rest of the routing under their issue and flight, then its other ones
        nxt = _ug_issue(jobs[0], kb0, 0, UG_FIRST)
        _route_end(c, states, picks, span)
        nxt = nxt + _ug_issue(jobs[0], kb0, UG_FIRST, UG_BLOCKS - UG_FIRST)
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        if not early_x:
            _x_polled(c, xq, xs, HIDDEN)
        es += [_bits(fx.ptr_load(ids + row * SLOTS + pick0 + j * span)) for j in range(1, s)]
        owns = _ug_owns(c, es, [j * s + row for j in range(s)], span)
        jobs += [_ug_job(c, es[j], tile, owns[j]) for j in range(1, s)]
        for r in range_constexpr(s):
            cur = nxt
            if const_expr(r + 1 < s):
                nxt = _ug_issue(jobs[r + 1], kb0)
            accs = gemv_lanes(HIDDEN, [jobs[r]], lane, x_lds, cur, kb0, UG_BLOCKS)[0]
            # every row choosing the expert, at its slot of it, by its owner
            k_col = fx.Int32(-1)
            for k in range_constexpr(TOPK):
                at = ids + fx.min(col, s - 1) * SLOTS + k
                k_col = (_bits(fx.ptr_load(at)) == es[r]).select(fx.Int32(k), k_col)
            _ug_emit(c, accs, tile, owns[r] & (col < s) & (k_col >= 0), k_col)
    else:
        _route(c)
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        q = shared.select(t + CTAS - UG_TPE, t - UG_TPE)
        slot, tile = q // UG_TPE, q % UG_TPE
        jobs = [_ug_job(c, _bits(fx.ptr_load(ids + r * SLOTS + slot)), tile, fx.Int32(r) < s) for r in range(s)]
        nxt = _ug_issue(jobs[0], kb0)
        if not early_x:
            _x_polled(c, xq, xs, HIDDEN)
        for r in range_constexpr(s):
            cur = nxt
            if const_expr(r + 1 < s):
                nxt = _ug_issue(jobs[r + 1], kb0)
            accs = gemv_lanes(HIDDEN, [jobs[r]], lane, x_lds, cur, kb0, UG_BLOCKS)[0]
            _ug_emit(c, accs, tile, (col < s) & (col == r), slot)


def _dn_unit(c, t, q):
    """DN's unit q of workgroup t's wave: (sample, slot, 128-k block) q // (2 SLOTS), q // 2 % SLOTS, q % 2 of the
    wave's 16-row group of the task's rows (DOWN_ROWS from t DOWN_ROWS, DN_WPG waves a group): the gemv_lanes unit
    (a lane outside the rows loads its twin's, lane ^ 8: the same lines), its (sample, slot), its block. Past the
    units, of no bytes."""
    lane, wave, s = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["s"]
    n_units = s * SLOTS * 2
    live = q < n_units
    qq = fx.min(q, n_units - 1)
    sample, slot, kc = qq // (2 * SLOTS), qq // 2 % SLOTS, qq % 2
    rg0, off = t * DOWN_ROWS // 16, t * DOWN_ROWS % 16
    gu = wave // DN_WPG
    lr = gu * 16 + lane % 16 - off
    w_ln = ((lr >= 0) & (lr < DOWN_ROWS)).select(lane, lane ^ 8)
    e = _bits(fx.ptr_load(_expert_lds(c)[0] + sample * SLOTS + slot))
    group = e * (HIDDEN // 16) + rg0 + gu
    unit = (
        (c["w2"], uniform(live.select(fx.Int32(W2_BYTES), fx.Int32(0)))),
        (c["w2_scale"], uniform(live.select(fx.Int32(W2_SCALE_BYTES), fx.Int32(0)))),
        group,
        w_ln,
        group,
        sample * SLOTS + slot,
    )
    return unit, sample, slot, kc, live


def _sld_f32(addr):
    """The f32 at a wave-uniform byte address, a scalar load issued here (volatile: not sunk to its use), off the
    vector memory queue."""
    ptr = llvm.IntToPtrOp(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<4>"), fx.Int64(addr).ir_value()).result
    return fx.Float32(llvm.LoadOp(T.f32, ptr, alignment=4, volatile_=True).result)


def _dn_issue(c, t, q):
    """DN's unit q's weight loads, issued now: (words, scale), the scale a scalar load (the wave's units in flight
    then bounded by the vector loads' count, 2 a unit)."""
    unit, _, _, kc, _ = _dn_unit(c, t, q)
    (w, w_bytes), _, wg, w_ln, sg, _ = unit
    w = rsrc(w, w_bytes)
    at = [((wg * (INTER // 64) + cc) * 64 + w_ln) * 4 for cc in (2 * kc, 2 * kc + 1)]
    ws = [bo.buffer_load(w, a, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=NT) for a in at]
    si = uniform(sg // 8 * (INTER // 128) + kc)
    return ws, _sld_f32(c["w2_scale"] + fx.Int64(si) * 4)


@flyc.jit
def stage_dn(c, t):
    """down on every (row, slot)'s h, each 128-group in E4M3 once (workgroup t's wave w group t + w CTAS, into
    mailboxes h8 and hs8; then every workgroup polls them all into LDS): the task's DOWN_ROWS output rows, a 16-row
    group DN_WPG waves, a wave every (sample, slot, 128-k block) DN_WPG-th of the group's (_dn_unit), each block's
    sums weighed by its h scale and route weight into its sample's column, DN_AHEAD units' weights in flight (the
    first ones before h); the group's waves' sums, the group's (TP) sums, plus the stream: the layer's out."""
    tid, lane, wave, s, tag = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["s"], c["tag"]
    n = s * SLOTS
    n_blk = n * (INTER // 128)
    upw = -(-n * 2 // DN_WPG)
    wq = wave % DN_WPG
    q0 = wq * upw
    # h's 128-groups in E4M3 once: group t + w CTAS by wave w's first 32 lanes, its poll ahead of the wave's
    # weight loads (a wave's loads return in order)
    for w in range_constexpr(-(-n_blk // CTAS)):
        qb = t + w * CTAS
        if (wave == w) & (lane < 32) & (qb < n_blk):
            e0 = qb * 128 + 4 * lane
            got_h = poll2n(c["mb"]["h"], [e0 // 2], tag, c["err"])[0]
            quantize_group4(bf16_values(got_h[0]) + bf16_values(got_h[1]), c["mb"]["h8"], c["mb"]["hs8"], e0, tag=tag)
    # the first units' weights before h8
    ahead = [_dn_issue(c, t, q0 + i) for i in range(min(DN_AHEAD, upw))]
    # every group, one wait: its words and scales into LDS
    words, coef = c["lds"] + WAVES * 256, c["lds"] + WAVES * 256 + n_blk * 32
    n_w = n_blk * 32 // 2
    at_w = [fx.min(i * THREADS + tid, n_w - 1) * 2 for i in range(-(-n_w // THREADS))]
    at_s = [fx.min(i * THREADS + tid, n_blk // 2 - 1) * 2 for i in range(-(-n_blk // 2 // THREADS))]
    # the end's stream values in the same wait (a thread past the sums' the last's)
    q = fx.min(lane, fx.Int32(s * (DOWN_ROWS // 4) - 1))
    k0 = q // (DOWN_ROWS // 4) * HIDDEN + t * DOWN_ROWS + 4 * (q % (DOWN_ROWS // 4))
    boxes = [c["mb"]["h8"]] * len(at_w) + [c["mb"]["hs8"]] * len(at_s) + [c["own"]]
    got = poll2n(boxes, at_w + at_s + [c["sbase"] + k0 // 2], tag, c["err"], CM_SYS, batch=len(boxes))
    stream = got[-1:]
    for i in range_constexpr(len(at_w)):
        for e in range_constexpr(2):
            fx.ptr_store(got[i][e].bitcast(fx.Float32), words + at_w[i] + e)
    weights = _expert_lds(c)[5]
    for i in range_constexpr(len(at_s)):
        for e in range_constexpr(2):
            b = at_s[i] + e
            fx.ptr_store(got[len(at_w) + i][e].bitcast(fx.Float32) * fx.ptr_load(weights + b // 2), coef + b)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    # the units: a block's MFMA on its h block (the same for every column), its sum weighed into its sample's column
    col = fx.Int32(c["col"])
    acc = [fx.Float32(0.0)] * 4
    for i in range_constexpr(upw):
        if const_expr(i + DN_AHEAD < upw):
            ahead.append(_dn_issue(c, t, q0 + i + DN_AHEAD))
        ws, s_w = ahead[i]
        # unit q's 128-block of h is block q of the (sample, slot)s' blocks in order
        qu = q0 + i
        at = [words + qu * 32 + (h * 64 + (lane // 16) * 16) // 4 for h in range(2)]
        xs = [fx.Vector(fx.ptr_load(a, result_type=T.vec(4, T.f32))).bitcast(fx.Int32) for a in at]
        mfma = fx.Vector(_fp8_mfma(ws, xs))
        k = ((qu < 2 * n) & (col == qu // (2 * SLOTS))).select(s_w * fx.ptr_load(coef + qu), fx.Float32(0.0))
        acc = [acc[e] + mfma[e] * k for e in range(4)]
    # the task's sums (a group's waves' in turn) into LDS, a sample's DOWN_ROWS in a row; then every wave puts
    # them into its TP ranks' peer buffers (ranks w, w + WAVES, ..), wave 0 polls the group's sums, plus the stream
    red, outs = c["lds"], c["lds"] + WAVES * 256 + MAX_ROWS * SLOTS * (INTER // 4)
    for e in range_constexpr(4):
        fx.ptr_store(acc[e], red + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4 + e)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    off = t * DOWN_ROWS % 16
    for i in range_constexpr(-(-s * DOWN_ROWS // THREADS)):
        j = i * THREADS + tid
        if j < s * DOWN_ROWS:
            row = j % DOWN_ROWS + off
            src = (row % 16 // 4) * 16 + j // DOWN_ROWS
            v = fx.ptr_load(red + (((row // 16) * DN_WPG) * 64 + src) * 4 + row % 4)
            for w in range_constexpr(1, DN_WPG):
                v = v + fx.ptr_load(red + (((row // 16) * DN_WPG + w) * 64 + src) * 4 + row % 4)
            fx.ptr_store(v, outs + j)
    held = lane < s * (DOWN_ROWS // 4)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if held:
        mine = [fx.ptr_load(outs + 4 * q + e) for e in range(4)]
        for p in range_constexpr(c["tp"]):
            if wave == p % WAVES:
                _group_put4(c, 1, k0, mine, [p])
    if (wave == 0) & held:
        group = _group_poll4(c, 1, k0)
        sv = bf16_values(stream[0][0]) + bf16_values(stream[0][1])
        out4 = [sv[e] + group[e] for e in range(4)]
        bo.buffer_store(
            fx.Vector.from_elements([bf16_pair(out4[0], out4[1]), bf16_pair(out4[2], out4[3])], fx.Int32),
            c["out"],
            k0 // 2,
        )


@flyc.jit
def stage_d1(c, t):
    """gate_up's 16-row group t of the dense MLP on every row's normalized stream, quantized into the task's
    slot: into mailbox dgu. Its first weights load while it waits."""
    ahead = gemv_split_ahead(c["gate_up_weight"], c["gate_up_scale"], HIDDEN, [t], c["lane"], c["wave"])
    gq = c["scratch"] + c["off"]["gq"] + fx.Int64(t) * (c["s"] * HIDDEN)
    gs = c["scratch"] + c["off"]["gs"] + fx.Int64(t) * (c["s"] * HIDDEN // 128 * 4)
    for row in range_constexpr(c["s"]):
        x = _rmsnorm_values(c, _poll_stream_row(c, row))
        rmsnorm_quant_values(x, None, rsrc(gq), rsrc(gs), c["eps"], row, HIDDEN, c["tid"], c["lds"])
    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    acc = gemv_split(
        c["gate_up_weight"],
        c["gate_up_scale"],
        rsrc(gq, c["s"] * HIDDEN),
        rsrc(gs, c["s"] * HIDDEN // 128 * 4),
        HIDDEN,
        [t],
        c["lane"],
        c["wave"],
        c["lds"],
        ahead=ahead,
    )[0]
    _put_group(c, "dgu", DENSE_GATE_UP, t, acc)


@flyc.jit
def stage_d3(c, t):
    """down's groups O_GROUPS t .. + O_GROUPS - 1 on every row's silu(gate) * up, quantized into the task's
    slot; then the stream + the group's sums, the layer's out. Its first weights load while it waits."""
    tid, tag, err = c["tid"], c["tag"], c["err"]
    groups = [O_GROUPS * t + g for g in range(O_GROUPS)]
    ahead = gemv_split_ahead(c["down_weight"], c["down_scale"], DENSE_INTER, groups, c["lane"], c["wave"])
    uq = c["scratch"] + c["off"]["uq"] + fx.Int64(t) * (c["s"] * DENSE_INTER)
    us = c["scratch"] + c["off"]["us"] + fx.Int64(t) * (c["s"] * DENSE_INTER // 128 * 4)
    if tid < DENSE_INTER // 8:
        k0 = tid * 8
        # one wait for every row's
        got_all = poll2n(
            c["mb"]["dgu"],
            [
                row * DENSE_GATE_UP + half * DENSE_INTER + k0 + 2 * m
                for row in range(c["s"])
                for half in range(2)
                for m in range(4)
            ],
            tag,
            err,
            batch=min(8 * c["s"], 32),
        )
        for row in range_constexpr(c["s"]):
            got = got_all[8 * row : 8 * row + 8]
            gate = [_f32(w) for pair in got[:4] for w in pair]
            up = [_f32(w) for pair in got[4:] for w in pair]
            y = [fx.Float32((gate[j] * sigmoid(gate[j]) * up[j]).to(fx.BFloat16)) for j in range(8)]
            quantize_group(y, rsrc(uq), rsrc(us), row, DENSE_INTER, k0)
    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    accs = gemv_split(
        c["down_weight"],
        c["down_scale"],
        rsrc(uq, c["s"] * DENSE_INTER),
        rsrc(us, c["s"] * DENSE_INTER // 128 * 4),
        DENSE_INTER,
        groups,
        c["lane"],
        c["wave"],
        c["lds"],
        ahead=ahead,
    )
    # wave g finishes group g
    acc = accs[0]
    for g in range_constexpr(1, O_GROUPS):
        acc = [(c["wave"] == g).select(a, b) for a, b in zip(accs[g], acc)]
    if (c["wave"] < O_GROUPS) & (c["col"] < c["s"]):
        n = c["col"] * HIDDEN + (O_GROUPS * t + c["wave"]) * 16 + (c["lane"] // 16) * 4
        total = _group_sum4(c, 1, n, acc)
        stream = poll2n(c["own"], [c["sbase"] + n // 2], tag, err, CM_SYS)[0]
        sv = bf16_values(stream[0]) + bf16_values(stream[1])
        outs = [sv[e] + total[e] for e in range(4)]
        bo.buffer_store(
            fx.Vector.from_elements([bf16_pair(outs[0], outs[1]), bf16_pair(outs[2], outs[3])], fx.Int32),
            c["out"],
            n // 2,
        )

    rank][EXCHANGE] pairs, then the stream [half][STREAM_PAIRS] pairs (O's owners put each rank's columns into its
